text.p: Pakistan Telecommunications Company Ltd (PTCL) fell 0.65 rupees, or 2.01 percent, to 31.60 on Tuesday on selling of its global depositary receipt (GDR) in international markets, dealers said.
Turnover of 4.419 million PTCL shares had been recorded by midsession.
"Foreign investors are gradually selling PTCL because there is little hope of the company's early privatisation," dealer Ather Raouf said.
The government has long sought to sell a 26 percent stake in PTCL to a strategic investor, but has yet to announce a deadline for potential bidders to pre-qualify.
PTCL has not announced its results for 1995/96 (July-June) and has given no dividend or earnings for its shareholders since it was listed in 1994.
"There is no chance of PTCL announcing its results soon, which has also dampened sentiment," dealer Ali Asghar said.
